mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at City Hall with a current air quality index of 51. You will see a first quarter moon tonight, and the space station will be visible for a brief pass at 3:23 AM as it travels from Belleville toward Fitchburg. Overnight, we expect a low of 63 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city has two important updates. First, the Public Works department is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee construction and utility projects through September 20. Second, homeowners can now apply for a thirty dollar rebate for installing rain barrels to help manage stormwater utility costs.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, we have the Epic User Group Meeting, yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from Friday, an officer arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle near North Main Street.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. The shop is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a scoop.
